full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white photograph shows two women facing one another in a steep, shadowed interior stairwell. The woman on the left leans slightly forward from a dark railing, her profile and short light hair outlined by light from above. The woman on the right sits or rests against the opposite side, her dark dress and gathered hair almost merging into the wall's shadow. Their faces are turned toward each other, leaving a narrow bright interval between the profiles. The gestures are quiet and restrained; the exact conversation, if any, remains unknown. A large high window occupies the upper center, its rectangular panes glowing nearly white. Sunlight descends from it into a pale cone of haze, illuminating the textured rear wall and tracing thin luminous rims along hair and shoulders. The top and sides of the space curve into a dark arch-like enclosure. On the left, the stair rail cuts diagonally upward and partially disappears behind the foreground figure. The right wall carries slanting window-frame shadows and rough stone or plaster texture. Lower portions of both figures and the stairwell become nearly black, with only a few narrow highlights defining a sleeve, a fold, and the curve of a hand. The composition is sharply divided between the white window and deep black human silhouettes, yet soft mid-gray light fills the gap between them. Coarse grain and slight atmospheric haze keep the photograph tactile. The figures occupy the lower half; the luminous window and enclosing architecture dominate above. No readable writing appears. The whole frame feels intimate and theatrical without a visible stage, as if an ordinary pause has been transformed by the strong geometry of natural light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白照片中，两名女子在陡峭、暗影浓重的室内楼梯间相对而立。左侧女子从深色扶栏旁稍稍前倾，侧脸和浅色短发被上方来光勾出轮廓。右侧女子坐着或倚在对面，深色衣裙和挽起的头发几乎并入墙影。两张脸转向彼此，侧影之间留出一条狭窄的明亮间隔。姿态安静而克制；她们是否交谈、在说什么都无从得知。高处一扇大窗占据上方中央，矩形窗格几乎亮成白色。阳光从那里倾入一锥浅色雾霭，照出后墙肌理，并在头发和肩部边缘勾出细亮线。空间的顶部和两侧弯成深色拱形围合。左边楼梯扶手斜向上切入，部分消失在前景人物身后。右墙留有斜向窗框影和粗糙石材或灰泥纹理。两人下半身与楼梯间底部几乎变黑，只有几处窄亮点界定袖口、衣褶和手部曲线。构图被白色窗口和深黑人物剪影强烈分割，但柔和中灰光填满两人之间。粗颗粒和轻微空气雾让照片保有触感。人物占下半幅；发亮窗口与围合建筑在上方占主导。没有可读字样。整幅画面亲密而有戏剧性，却不见舞台，像普通停顿被自然光的强烈几何形态改变了。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast monochrome photography shapes an intimate scene through a brilliant upper opening and deep enclosing shadow. Backlight draws thin white rims along hair, fabric, and curved forms, while faces remain mostly in profile or partial darkness. An arching dark frame and one strong diagonal guide the eye toward a narrow zone of interaction below the light. Dusty mid-gray haze softens the distance between pure white and near black. Rough wall texture and visible grain preserve a physical, old-film surface. The composition gives luminous architecture generous space above compact figures, creating theatrical tension from natural light and stillness alone.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差单色摄影以明亮的上方开口和深而围合的阴影塑造亲密场景。逆光沿头发、布料与弯曲形体勾出细白边，面部大多留在侧影或局部暗处。拱形暗框和一道强斜线把视线引向光线下方狭窄的互动区域。含尘般的中灰雾气柔化纯白与近黑之间的距离。粗糙墙面肌理和可见颗粒保留旧胶片的物理表面。构图让发光结构在紧凑形体上方占有充足空间，仅以自然光和静止感产生戏剧张力。
theme_en: Two women facing one another in a shadowed stairwell
theme_zh: 两名女子在暗影楼梯间相对而立
name: Herbert List
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
